detail.longDescription: I was using Linux, the Zed editor and the rustc 1.101.0-nightly (7df81381d 2026-10-14) version. When I cloned the Clippy repository and ran cargo check then it succeeds, but the code completion is not working. According to the Getting code-completion for rustc internals , I had to set the { "rust-analyzer.rustc.source": "discover" } LSP configuration in the settings.json file: { // other configs "lsp": { "rust-analyzer": { "initialization_options": { "rustc": { "source": "discover" } } } } } However, it still not solved the code completion. The problem was that the extern rustc crates could not be resolved. I reached out the Zulip message board, and someone provided the following workaround.
